For caring, committed dog owners who are looking for ways to help their older dogs live the longest, healthiest, pain-free lives possible, so they can be in your world for longer.

Our channel is devoted to sharing proven, effective information and resources to help your older dog move better, get up easier have the best quality of life possible in their senior years.

We'll also share inspiring stories of devoted dog owners who made life-changing differences for their dogs, dogs just like yours.

If you would like to learn how to help your older dog get a new lease of life and enjoy their life to the fullest, join our Free 'Eternal Older Dog' Community Here - https://www.skool.com/the-eternal-older-dog-1644/about

Help us spread the word by sharing our content and help more caring dog owners make game-changing differences to their dogs quality of life.

www.yourolderdogandarthritis.com
